simple.meaning: אֵסַר־חַדּוֹן (ʼÊçar-Chaddôwn) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in 2 Kings, Ezra, Isaiah, beginning at 2 Kings 19:37. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, kingship, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֵסַר־חַדּוֹן (H634) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows אֵסַר־חַדּוֹן through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.full: H634. Esarchaddon אֵסַרְחַדֹּן proper name, masculine Esarhaddon (Assyrian Ašura—-iddina , Ashur hath given a brother ) king of Assyria B.C. 681-668, son & successor of Sennacherib Isa 37:38 = 2Kin 19:37 (van d. H. אֵסַרחַֿדֹּן ); Ezra 4:2 ; compare COT.
